purpose: Local review inventory, not a substitute for committed source-bound acceptance

cases.requiredAcceptance: Loaded Jellyfin history: Issues remains responsive and returns the newest attempts.
Fresh install and real legacy XML upgrade/restart: scan, preview, approve, real fix, rescan and restore; unrelated settings and approvals preserved.
Large-library scan: browser progress stays live, requests finish, and scan duration/resource use are measured.

Owned managed artwork and orphan metadata execute with all/selected libraries after a confirming successful host scan; changed observations, returning/disabled owners, custom roots, escapes and protected paths remain safe.
Reporter-equivalent Rafa inventory and saved settings: Spanish original survives scan, approval, real cleanup and rescan; retained stream hashes verified.
Jellyfin 10.11 and 12 artwork workflows: SVG, healthy replacements and infrastructure failures preserved; real corruption handled recoverably, including persistence/disposal failure.
Windows service-account UNC/NAS: ReportedUncAcceptanceTests passes, then an owned real re-encode preserves source/recycle hashes and restores successfully; measured shortage still blocks.
Reproduce both reported MKV failure classes with equivalent media/FFmpeg; repair safely, retain streams/dispositions and hashes, expose useful diagnostics and verify restoration.
Owned loose/TV/shared-artwork/cross-volume moves: partial failures stay reviewable, restart recovery and Undo restore exact paths and hashes.
Trace exact issue IDs through preview, no-change, refusal, failure and rescan; unchanged files never appear as completed repairs or earn savings.
